_note: This file is a declarative MMEngine configuration file for MAE ViT-Base pretraining on ImageNet. It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only configuration dictionaries and variable assignments consumed by the MMPretrain training framework.
configure_mae_vit_base_optimizer: configure the AdamW optimizer with AMP wrapper and weight decay exclusions for MAE ViT-Base pretraining
configure_learning_rate_schedule: configure a linear warmup followed by cosine annealing LR schedule over 400 epochs
configure_training_runtime: configure the epoch-based training loop with 400 max epochs and checkpoint hooks
configure_auto_lr_scaling: configure automatic learning rate scaling based on a base batch size of 4096
configure_randomness_seed: configure deterministic training with seed 0 and different rank seeds for distributed training
